data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Specify the remediation-message content contract. AC8 requires a 'remediation message' on the missing-binary branch but does not define what counts as remediation. Amend AC8: the message MUST contain an install hint substring (one of: 'install', 'brew', or a URL) so the test asserts actionability, not just non-zero exit. This prevents a GREEN script that exits non-zero with only 'fail' from passing the test.
